system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: "instruction": "We detail name, description, input(parameters) and output(returns) of each action as follows:
system_prompt_style.note: Per-environment task instruction given as first human turn (e.g. 'You are web shopping.'); rendering code not shown in evidence.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Every round I will give you an observation and a list of available actions, you have to respond an action based on the state and instruction.
env_context_strategy.note: Environments are text games/web/tool tasks; context is the env observation each round, not repository context.

context_compaction.note: Generation uses max_length; no history processor visible in evidence.

observation_format.evidence_quote: `/observation` to get the current observation from the environment
observation_format.note: Observations shown as text strings, e.g. 'WebShop [SEP] Instruction: [SEP] ...'.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: It features diverse interactive environments and tasks with a unified format, i.e., ReAct format.
tool_call_format.note: Actions are free text after 'Action:' (e.g. click[Buy Now]); no value in the list fits this exactly. json_in_text is the closest match; a text-action format would fit better. No line number is available in the excerpt.

tool_count.note: Action spaces vary per environment; no single tool schema list.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: It includes 14 environments across web navigating, text games, house-holding tasks, digital games, embodied tasks, tool-using and programming.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Name: get_search_movie(movie_name)\nDescription: Search for a movie by name and return basic details

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: different environments are deployed on different servers or ports and provide encapsulated HTTP services externally
protocol_standardization.note: Proprietary HTTP env API; no MCP/A2A seen.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: It features diverse interactive environments and tasks with a unified format, i.e., ReAct format.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: We adopt ReAct [35] to modeling agent outputs, where the LLM-based agent generates a reasoning thought be- fore outputting an action.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: AgentController is our core component that connects the agent and the environment.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: AgentController is our core component that connects the agent and the environment.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: AgentController is our core component that connects the agent and the environment. It is responsible for evaluating the agent, collecting data, and training the agent.

long_term_memory.note: Learning is via weight updates (AgentEvol), not runtime memory.

self_verification.note: Environment reward used for scoring/training, not in-loop verification.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: the agent interacts with the environment until the task ends or exceeds the maximum number of steps
termination_condition.note: max_rounds in Evaluator.eval; task end signalled by environment 'terminated'; model_declared inferred from env termination on actions like click[Buy Now]; max_length also bounds generation.

cost_controls.note: vLLM enable_prefix_caching is inference-engine caching when VLLM engine is selected.

timeouts.note: Client timeout arg for env HTTP calls; semantics not shown.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: different environments are deployed on different servers or ports and provide encapsulated HTTP services externally
execution_isolation.note: Env servers are separate HTTP services (often localhost); closest value.

permission_model.note: Invalid actions: 'If the action is not valid, perform nothing.'

tracing.evidence_quote: While evaluating the model, this script also saves the trajectories to a file, which can be used for further training or analysis.

replayability.evidence_quote: Researchers can replay and inspect full trajectories, step through agent decision-making, and analyze model behaviors more easily.

target_domain.evidence_quote: It includes 14 environments across web navigating, text games, house-holding tasks, digital games, embodied tasks, tool-using and programming.
target_domain.note: Research/training platform for agents; embodied/games coded other.

model_agnostic.note: HF transformers models, vLLM, and OpenAI-compatible APIAgent.
